description: The Open Cadastral Map is a map service from EuroGeographics, the association of European mapping and cadastral agencies, published on its Open Maps For Europe portal. The dataset page read on 2026-09-28 describes it as a single place to see which authoritative, INSPIRE-compliant cadastral data are available and where, covering four data types: administrative units, cadastral parcels and zones, buildings and building parts, and addresses, at scales down to 1:100. It is served as WMS and WMTS map services in ETRS89 coordinates and updated once a year, last in September 2025, while the source agencies may update more often. Coverage is 15 countries: Belgium, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Greece, Ireland, Latvia, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Poland, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain and Switzerland, and not every country supplies every layer. Access to the map services is free; downloads come from each national provider, and the licence terms were not read. Caveats: the page calls the service a prototype, and it offers no bulk download itself. It supports exposure and digital twin studies, such as locating building footprints and parcels across borders for a flood or earthquake exposure model. Related records: the Dutch and Latvian national cadastres.
